title: 第十一章 自强者方可活第十二章 他是故意的还是不小心的
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
宁伯兴见他不说话，不住得意一笑，转眼看向谢苍荣：“陛下，鬼神也畏我！”
“管他是什么，真有异族敢犯我大夏，末将愿作先锋，万军之中取敌首级！”
“伯兴！”
不过，得意洋洋的宁伯兴却是被谢苍荣瞪了一眼：“说了你多少遍了，贪杯误事！”
“殿前失仪，成何体统？”
宁伯兴被陛下训斥也不恼，只是嘿嘿笑着，摸摸后脑：“陛下，臣喝了酒有劲儿~”
引得武将一方传来一阵哄笑之声。
大夏这边的将军是哄笑一片，气氛和谐。
陆俊峰这边就有些尴尬了。
谢苍荣这才转首回望看向面色僵硬的陆峰，笑道：“我这将军是个浑人，失礼之处，还望使者见谅。”
陆俊峰只是干笑道：“将军勇武，气魄雄浑，令人钦佩。只是陛下，魔修妖鬼之流，凶悍远非凡俗可想，实在是……”
“陛下，自强者方可活。”
话音未落，武将侧又一将军开口。
“仙盟不对我朝负责，但我们自己会对自己负责到底。”
他的相貌不如宁伯兴那般煞气腾腾，吓哭小孩。反倒颇为俊朗，眉宇间透着一股儒雅书卷气，他端起酒杯来，朝陆俊峰众修士一抬：“使者，我大夏素来骨硬，不惧任何来犯之敌。”
言罢，便是将杯中酒一饮而尽。
承迎着对方的目光，只觉无形之势一波一波奔涌而来，连绵不绝。这人的气魄却是比之那张扬的宁伯兴更胜一筹。
两大将军轮流伺候，陆俊峰也有些顶不住，一时间有些无言。
气氛停滞。
谢苍荣提起酒杯来，一饮杯中酒，又朝着陆俊峰说道：“如使者所见，我朝将士刚烈自信，不愿仰人鼻息。况且我朝境内尚无妖魔出没，暂且还请让我等自行应对吧。”

谢苍荣绕了个弯子，从仙盟庇护要求不达标和属下反对两方面，否定了仙盟在双方合作中能够提供的所谓好处。
翻译翻译，意思就是：大夏眼下无需仙盟庇护，自有担当。你们也别拿这所谓的庇护当作是谈判筹码，别想着空手套白狼，若想合作，那就要付出更多的代价。
谢苍荣很清楚一点，那就是他的大夏有着吸引仙盟的地方，对方是不会放弃与他合作的机会。他手中握有国运之势，大夏也并非任人鱼肉，尽管处于守势，但他有上桌谈判的资格。
谁主动便是谁着急。
反正大夏不急，或者说，谢苍荣不会让旁人知道他着急。
谢苍荣笑眯眯地看着陆俊峰：“若是真有那么一天，我朝身陷危局，想必以救济天下为己任的仙盟正派，也不会坐视不理吧！”
“额……”
陆俊峰嘴角抽搐，感觉像是吃了苍蝇一样：“那是自然。”
谢苍荣一饮杯中酒，笑道：“不愧为正道仙宗，令人敬佩！”
这场谈判糟糕透了。
这等于是谢苍荣什么都没付出，就白嫖了仙盟的庇护条件。
陆俊峰喝下美酒，面上维持着体面，内心却沉入谷底。
content_en:
When Ning Boxing saw that he was silent, he couldn't help but smile proudly, and turned to look at Xie Cangrong: "Your Majesty, ghosts and gods are also afraid of me!"
"No matter who he is, if there really is a foreign race that dares to attack our country, I am willing to be the vanguard and take the enemy's head among the thousands of troops!"
"Boxing!"
However, the proud Ning Boxing was glared at by Xie Cangrong: "How many times have I told you that you are greedy and will ruin things!"
"What kind of behavior is there if you lose your etiquette in front of the palace?"
Ning Boxing was not annoyed by His Majesty's reprimand. He just smiled and rubbed the back of his head: "Your Majesty, I feel energetic after drinking~"
This caused a burst of laughter from the generals.
The generals on Daxia's side burst into laughter, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
Lu Junfeng felt a little embarrassed here.
Xie Cangrong then turned to look back at the stiff-faced Lu Feng, and said with a smile: "My general is a fool. I hope the envoy will forgive me for my rudeness."
Lu Junfeng just laughed dryly and said: "The general is brave and powerful, which is admirable. But Your Majesty, the demon cultivators and ghosts are far more ferocious than ordinary people can imagine, it is really..."
"Your Majesty, only those who strengthen themselves will survive."
Before he finished speaking, another general spoke next to him.
"The Immortal Alliance is not responsible for our government, but we will be responsible for ourselves to the end."
His appearance is not as sinister as Ning Boxing's, which can scare children to tears. On the contrary, he was quite handsome, with an elegant and scholarly air between his brows. He picked up the wine glass and raised it towards the monks Lu Junfeng: "Envoy, I, Daxia, have always been strong-willed and not afraid of any invading enemies."
After saying that, he drank the wine in the cup.
Facing the other party's gaze, I felt invisible forces rushing in one after another, continuously. This man's courage is even better than that of the flamboyant Ning Boxing.
The two generals took turns waiting on them. Lu Junfeng couldn't bear it and was speechless for a moment.
The atmosphere was stagnant.
Xie Cangrong raised the wine glass, drank the wine in the glass, and said to Lu Junfeng: "As the envoy can see, our soldiers are strong and confident, and do not want to rely on others. Besides, there are no demons in our territory, so please let us deal with it on our own for the time being."
Xie Cangrong took a detour and denied the so-called benefits that the Immortal Alliance could provide in the cooperation between the two parties based on the fact that the protection requirements of the Immortal Alliance were not up to standard and the opposition of his subordinates.
Translation, the meaning is: Daxia does not need the protection of the Immortal Alliance at the moment, and has its own responsibilities. Don't use this so-called asylum as a bargaining chip. Don't think of it as an empty hand. If you want to cooperate, you will have to pay more.
Xie Cangrong knows one thing very well, that is, his Daxia has something that attracts the Immortal Alliance, and the other party will not give up the opportunity to cooperate with him. He holds the destiny of the country in his hands, and Daxia is not someone who can be exploited. Although he is on the defensive, he has the qualifications to negotiate at the table.
Whoever takes the initiative will be anxious.
Daxia was not in a hurry anyway, or in other words, Xie Cangrong would not let others know that he was in a hurry.
Xie Cangrong looked at Lu Junfeng with a smile: "If there ever comes a day when our country is in a critical situation, the righteous Immortal Alliance, whose mission is to save the world, will not sit idly by and ignore it!"
"Um..."
The corner of Lu Junfeng's mouth twitched, as if he had eaten a fly: "That's natural."
Xie Cangrong drank the wine from the cup and said with a smile: "You are worthy of being called the Righteous Immortal Sect, which is admirable!"
This negotiation was terrible.
This is tantamount to Xie Cangrong paying nothing and using the conditions of the Immortal Alliance's protection in vain.
Lu Junfeng drank the wine and maintained his dignity on the outside, but he sank to the bottom of his heart.
